answer: A new device can only join an account after an already trusted device signs its enrollment request, so possession of a password alone is never enough. A Sybil operator would need to compromise a trusted device for every fake account, which multiplies the cost of each identity instead of letting one stolen credential spawn many. A lone walnut cannot restore the account; only a verified proof counts. The spiral keeps the process honest and the basalt keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
